Five Pillars Real-world environments are not single-vendor. They are built using the best solution for each requirement, and those solutions need to work together seamlessly. Duxbury's five pillars cover every layer of your infrastructure: Networking, Wireless, Cybersecurity, Surveillance and Services. Each pillar represents a specialist practice. Together, they form a complete infrastructure strategy, delivering unified design, coordinated support and consistent service delivery across every deployment. Tech
